name: Летопись в «Страннике»: пять городов, пятеро Энтериалов и две сцены Спуска — картинки глав (слова автора 29.09.2026: «покажем и вид городов по их описанию, но без Эуклида, и вид Энтериалов»). Города — по облику из свода лора (разделы «Пять городов», «Облик»), без тайн городов и без Эуклида. Энтериалы — как их видит вера этеров: величественная фигура в рясе путника, свой карст и своё оружие, по «Глубокому промту персонажа» (art/style/style.md): кто он и чего хочет сейчас · характер в лице и осанке · поза словами в миг действия · пять деталей · место. Боги — не отливки: ни форм, ни литья, ни статуй. Формат глав — 21:9: баннер над текстом режет середину, «Пятеро» — пять узких полос по центру картинок богов. Выгрузка — design/ui/assets/art/lore/<имя>.jpg, 1584×672 (половина 3168×1344), строки в tools/art-gen/ui-art.json добавляет выгрузка. Тексты глав — tools/content-gen/lore/chapters.js, черновик — docs/content/летопись.md
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, legendary key art with a sense of great scale and awe. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within, fire, water that shines — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes, sparks and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing: books, tablets, banners, signs and walls carry no writing at all — only blank surfaces or long straight parallel grooves. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. No occult symbols, no pentagrams. No gore, no blood, no skulls, no bones, no corpses, no undead, no monsters, no demons. No purple, no violet, no magenta light.

lore-places.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: wide cinematic panorama, 21:9, for a chapter page of the game's chronicle — the book in which an old storyteller tells the player about the world. It is key art of a legendary place, painted with awe and a sense of great scale, as the storyteller would describe it. The game shows the picture as a wide banner above the chapter text and may crop it to a narrower band through its middle, so the main subject sits in the middle band of the picture, between 25% and 75% of the height; the top may hold sky or vault, the bottom may fall into shadow. Atmospheric depth, a few strong light sources, light rising from below. No characters in the foreground: people appear only as tiny specks for scale.

lore-gods.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: wide cinematic key art, 21:9, for a chapter page of the game's chronicle about the five gods who, as every people of this world believes, created it. It shows one god as the faithful picture him: a living, majestic, towering man of flesh and breath — a legend, not a statue, not an idol, not a relief, not a carving, not a cast or a mold, not metal, no cracks on his skin. The god stands in the center of the picture, horizontally centered, and fills its height from above his head to below his waist; his face and shoulders sit in the middle band of the picture, between 25% and 55% of the height, because the game shows the picture as a wide band through its middle and also as a narrow vertical slice through its center. The camera is low and looks up, so he towers over the land below him. He wears the long hooded robe of a wanderer — the five gods walked among the peoples as wanderers in hooded robes, each with his own weapon. His element lives around him, painted in the light of his crystal; light comes from below. To his left and right his domain spreads out in atmospheric depth. Pathos: divine, calm power; reverence and awe. Exactly one figure in the picture; he has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; his eyes are alive.

lore-still.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: wide cinematic still life, 21:9, for a chapter page of the game's chronicle — the book in which an old storyteller tells the player about the world. The objects are large and close, painted with weight and reverence, in a dark place lit from below. The game shows the picture as a wide banner above the chapter text and may crop it to a narrower band through its middle, so the objects sit in the middle band of the picture, between 25% and 75% of the height. No people, no hands, no characters.

jobs.title: Эндалор — парящий город магов над проломом богов (глава «Эндалор»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Эндалор — центр, Рэдмунд, время, Энериум»: «Облик» и «История» — диск выше облаков в крепостной стене со знамёнами, машинное нутро с синими накопителями, цепи, шестерни, огни в облаках, город горит Энериумом; кварталы школ со знаками стихий; Иллюзориум — две руки с раскрытой книгой, Башня вневремени — чёрный глухой обелиск, Довод — круг поединков, дворфский квартал. Без заброшенного квартала (тайна города) и без Эуклида: пролом внизу — только тьма. К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-city-endalor__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/city-endalor.jpg, 1584×672. v1 — время над кварталом школы вышло современным значком часов со стрелками, v2 — песочные часы из кристалла; v2 — знаки стали кристаллами, но здание-книга вышло дважды, а обелиск срезан верхним краем; v3 — одно здание-книга, весь город и обелиск в кадре
jobs.subject: Subject: Endalor, the flying city of mages, the heart of the world, seen from a little below and to the side at dusk. Who it is: an enormous disc of a city that hangs high above a sea of clouds over the great chasm in the middle of the world; it has no land of its own. Its underside is a massive machine belly of dark iron and stone: great supports with glowing blue accumulator cells, huge hanging chains, gears, rows of lights shining down into the clouds. The city burns green crystal every second, and a steady green glow pours from its underside down onto the clouds, visible from far away. On top: a fortress wall with long banners runs around the rim; above the wall rise the quarters of five schools of magic, each in its own color and style, and above each quarter floats a large symbol of its element, made of glowing crystal and light like an old enchanted sculpture, not a flat icon: a drop of water glowing blue; an hourglass of green crystal with green sand pouring through its waist — an hourglass, not a clock: no clock face, no dial, no hands, no arrows; a boulder glowing amber; a whirlwind glowing white-green; a flame glowing scarlet. Three landmarks, each appearing exactly once: one single great building shaped like two gigantic stone hands holding up an open book with blank stone pages — there is only one such building in the whole city; one black obelisk without windows or doors, the tallest thing in the city, like a hole cut out of the picture, and its sharp tip stands fully inside the picture with open sky above it; one small round ring of stone for duels between mages. At one edge, a dark heavy quarter of the dwarves with chimneys and smoke. Far below, through a break in the clouds, the dark mouth of a chasm in the earth — only darkness inside, nothing at all can be seen in its depth. Light: the main light comes from below — the green glow from the city's underside lights the clouds and the city's rim from beneath; warm golden windows; a cold blue dusk sky above. Composition: the whole city disc is seen from a distance and fits inside the picture with sky around it, filling the middle band, slightly left of center; the black obelisk rises above the skyline and its tip is well below the top edge; clouds and the dark chasm below; the lower part of the picture is darker. Mood: awe, old magic, hidden machinery.

jobs.title: Норден-Вильд — крепость севера с Ареной и Храмом Огня (глава «Норден-Вильд»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Норден-Вильд — север, Кэрон, огонь, Нитриум», «Облик»: крепость тёмного камня на морском берегу, концентрические стены и кольца кварталов, в центре Арена, дома ярлов, длинные дома, Храм Огня в скале с пламенем в проёме, кузнечный квартал уступами, гавань внутри крепости с молами и башнями на волнорезах. Без противника в капюшоне и штольни за завалом (тайны севера). К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-city-nordenvild__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/city-nordenvild.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Norden-Vild, the fortress city of the harsh north, seen from the sea on a winter night. An enormous fortress of dark stone on a rocky sea shore, with concentric walls and quarters laid out in rings. In the very center lies a great open arena of sand, a colosseum, and from it the rings spread outward: nearest to the sand the heavy stone houses of the jarls, farther out the long houses with turf roofs, barracks, the market and the quarter for strangers. Above the city rises a cliff, and cut into it is the Temple of Fire: a portal of massive columns, a long stair climbing up to it and an open flame burning in the doorway, seen from the sea and from the mountains. Down the slope below the temple the forges lie in steps: chimneys, glow and smoke. A harbour inside the fortress walls: stone moles, towers on the breakwaters, longships of war and fishing boats. Beyond the walls, snowy fjords and dark mountains. Light: the scarlet-red glow of the forges and of the temple flame rises from below and from within, the arena is lit by rings of fire; a cold blue snowy night, a dark sea. Composition: the ring city with the arena at its heart fills the middle band; the temple on the cliff above and to the right; the harbour in the foreground on the left; the bottom of the picture is dark water.

jobs.title: Стоун-Хейм — город дворфов внутри горы Кароксорр (глава «Стоун-Хейм»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Стоун-Хейм — восток, Уларион, земля, Рубидиум»: «Гора и опасные земли», «Как он устроен», «Библиотека познания» — полость в толще горы, ярусы-уступы по стенам, плато, мосты, эстакады, рельсовые виадуки, клети подъёмников над пустотой, ворота у свода, площади с механизмом вместо фонтана, литейные с рыжим огнём, светлая колоннада Библиотеки под сводом, внизу рельсы, лебёдки и тьма. Без глубинников, клеток и нижних ярусов Библиотеки (тайны города). К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-city-stoneheim__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/city-stoneheim.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Stone-Heim, the underground city of the dwarves inside Karoxorr, a huge lone mountain in the east, seen from inside its great cavern. A vast hollow inside the mountain; the city sits on its walls in tiers and ledges. There are no streets: only plateaus, bridges, trestles, rail viaducts and lift cages hanging over the void on long cables. High under the vault, the grand gates with a pale shaft of daylight. Below them the living quarters, squares with a great clockwork mechanism instead of a fountain, markets, workshops and foundries with orange fire and pouring molten metal. Under the vault stands a long bright building with a colonnade, kept clean of smoke. Lower still, rails and winches, and at the very bottom of the hollow — darkness. Amber-orange light of glowing crystal lamps and foundry fire, steam and smoke, sparks. Tiny dwarf figures on the bridges and in the lift cages for scale. Light: warm amber and orange light rises from the foundries and crystal lamps below and lights the tiers from beneath; the vault above is in deep shadow. Composition: the far wall of the cavern with its tiers fills the middle band; bridges and viaducts cross the void in front of it; the bottom of the picture falls away into darkness. Mood: might, craft, order, depth.

jobs.title: Элайзис — кольцевой город эльфов вокруг Древа в Алаэльском лесу (глава «Элайзис»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Элайзис — юг, Виал, воздух, Элазиум», «Облик» и «Древо и есть храм»: кольцевой город на возвышении, ярусы белого камня, аркадные террасы с садами, Древо на вершине, корни спускаются по всем ярусам, водопады с каждого кольца, озёра и мосты, мягкий зелёно-золотой свет столбами, стен и ворот нет. Лес живой и здоровый — болезнь леса и дальний лес под запретом (тайна города). К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-city-elaizis__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/city-elaizis.jpg, 1584×672. v1 — Древо мельче города и чёрная полоса внизу кадра, v2 — Древо выше города, кадр до краёв
jobs.subject: Subject: Elaizis, the city of the elves in the heart of the vast Alael forest, in the evening. A ring city on a height: tiers of white stone, each ring an arcaded terrace with gardens, narrower the higher it goes. On the very top grows the Tree — a colossal ancient tree, taller than the whole city beneath it, its trunk as wide as the top ring, its crown spreading over the whole city like a sky, and its roots flow down over all the tiers into the ground: the city does not stand next to the tree, it embraces it. From every ring water falls: waterfalls, cascades, lakes below, slender bridges over them. There are no walls, no gates, no fortifications at all. Around it an endless ancient forest of giant trees, lush, green, healthy and alive. Light: soft green-gold light falls in beams through the crowns; white-green crystals glow gently among the roots and under the water; lanterns in the arcades; evening mist over the lakes. Composition: the ring city with the Tree fills the middle band; branches of the forest frame the top corners; lakes, bridges and mist in the foreground; the bottom of the picture is darker water; the painting fills the whole frame to every edge, with no black bars.

jobs.title: Лайтен-Гард — город суда и казны у падения реки к морю (глава «Лайтен-Гард»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Лайтен-Гард — запад, Армонт, вода, Паладиум», «Облик»: город по ступеням падения реки к морю — белый камень, красная черепица, террасы, водопады, каскады, мосты, акведуки, фонтаны; Храмовый холм со светлым зданием и синими шпилями, откуда начинается вода; арки Паладиума — каменные кольца с синим камнем в замке свода над каналами; большой каменный порт. Без вторых книг, Архива и браслетов скреплённых (тайны города). К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-city-laitengard__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/city-laitengard.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Laiten-Gard, the great stone port and the city of law in the west, at dusk. The city stands where a great river breaks into many branches and falls to the sea, and it is built along the steps of that fall: white stone, red tile roofs, terraces, waterfalls by the squares, cascades between the houses, bridges, aqueducts and fountains. On the very top rises the Temple Hill with a bright building crowned with blue spires, where the water begins. Over the canals hang stone ring-arches, each with a glowing deep-blue stone in its keystone. At the bottom, a big busy harbour of stone with many sailing ships and a lighthouse. Cypresses on the upper terraces. Light: the deep-blue glow of the stones in the arches and in the canals rises from below; warm lit windows; the last amber light of dusk on the white stone; a darkening blue sky. Composition: the city cascading down to the sea fills the middle band, the temple with blue spires on top; the harbour and ships in the foreground; the bottom of the picture is darker water.

jobs.title: Виал — первый из пятерых, воздух, Элазиум, лук (глава «Виал»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Пятеро Энтериалов» и «Виал — тот, что живёт»: разделил землю на края и вылепил тела, сосуды для жизни, единственный полюбил сделанное; стихия — воздух, карст — Элазиум (белый с прозеленью), оружие — лук; ходил путником в рясе. Детали — решение исполнителя по своду: глина на руках, птица из глины, песок струями (Мастерская форм). Без матери мира и «отливок». К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-gods/lore-god-vial__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/god-vial.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Vial, the first of the five gods, god of air, the sculptor of the world. Who he is: when the world was one formless substance, he divided it into lands — mountains, waters, deserts, forests and steppes — and with the same movement shaped the living bodies: people, elves, dwarves, beasts and plants. He made the vessels in which life became possible. He alone of the five came to love what he made. Right now he has just finished shaping a small living thing and lets it go into the world. Character: warm, attentive and patient, with a master craftsman's tenderness; a quiet, kind smile at the corners of his mouth, gentle eyes following the creature he has just released; an unhurried, generous bearing. His face: an ageless man with fine features, wind-blown light hair and a short beard. Pose, the moment of release: he stands tall with his weight on his back foot, his torso turned slightly to the right; his near hand is raised open at shoulder height, and from his palm a small pale bird, still the color of fresh clay, has just come alive and takes off in a swirl of white-green wind; his far hand holds a tall, slender bow of pale wood upright against his shoulder. His head is inclined toward the bird. He has exactly two arms: the near arm raised with the open palm, the far arm holding the bow. Details that tell his story: (1) his sleeves are rolled up, and his forearms and fingers are smudged with pale clay — he still works with his hands; (2) a long wanderer's robe of pale grey-green, the hood thrown back onto his shoulders, its hem torn and lifted by the wind; (3) the bowstring glows faintly white-green, and a few arrows sit in a simple quiver at his hip; (4) behind him thin streams of sand pour down from above like the columns of an hourglass nobody turns; (5) white-green crystals glow from within in the rocks at his feet. Place: a high cliff above a newly shaped land — below spread mountains, rivers, forests and steppes, some of the farthest still soft and unfinished like wet clay; white-green light rises from the crystals below; morning mist and wind.

jobs.title: Уларион — второй из пятерых, земля, Рубидиум, посох (глава «Уларион»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Уларион — бог знаний и созерцания»: вложил в тела способность познавать мир и себя, земля как основание, карст — Рубидиум (янтарно-оранжевый), оружие — посох; дворфы поняли его вернее всех; письмо на плитах может читать только он. Детали — решение исполнителя: плиты с прямыми бороздами вместо письма (правило style.md), борода с каменными кольцами. Без печати и Схождения. К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-gods/lore-god-ularion__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/god-ularion.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Ularion, the second of the five gods, god of knowledge and contemplation, god of earth. Who he is: after Vial shaped the bodies, they stood empty, and Ularion put into them the power to notice — to know the world and to know oneself. His earth is not hardness but foundation. The dwarves understood him most truly. Right now he reads the world: he has struck the rock with his staff, and the mountain answers him with light. Character: calm, deep and piercing, a patient scholar who sees through everything; heavy brows drawn together in concentration, wise eyes glowing faintly amber; an unhurried, rooted stance. His face: a strong, weathered face of an old man, broad nose, a long braided grey beard. Pose, the moment the mountain answers: he stands broad and firm, his weight on both feet; his near hand holds a tall staff of dark stone crowned with a large glowing amber crystal, its heel just struck into the rock, and from that point lines of amber light run away through the stone in long straight parallel grooves, like ruled lines with nothing written between them; his far hand is raised open at chest height, fingers spread, feeling the answer. His head is slightly lowered, his eyes on the light in the stone. He has exactly two arms: the near arm holding the staff, the far arm raised with an open hand. Details that tell his story: (1) small rings of polished stone are braided into his beard; (2) a heavy wanderer's robe of earth-brown and ochre, the hood thrown back, its hem grey with the dust of stone; (3) several stone tablets with long straight parallel grooves hang on a strap across his chest; (4) broad, calloused hands of a stonecutter; (5) amber crystals glow from within in the rock at his feet. Place: a vast hall of living rock inside a mountain, amber veins of crystal running through its walls; far below, the tiny lights of a city built into the rock; warm amber light rises from below.

jobs.title: Кэрон — третий из пятерых, огонь, Нитриум, двуручная секира (глава «Кэрон»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Кэрон — бог силы и битвы»: мощь тела, воля довести начатое до конца и ярость; уважает дело, не слова; учил, выходя противником; мерило — что человек делает со своим страхом; огонь, Нитриум (алый) разгорает то, что есть; оружие — двуручная секира. Детали — решение исполнителя: круг камней над северным морем, следы на песке. Без Схождения. К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-gods/lore-god-keron__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/god-keron.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: Keron, the third of the five gods, god of strength and battle, god of fire. Who he is: he gave the living three things — the might of the body, the will to finish what was begun, and fury, the power to go beyond one's own limit when there is no other way. He respects deeds, not words. He taught by stepping out and striking until you understood: he was the first opponent of everyone he taught. His only measure is fear: everyone fears, and he watches what a man does with his fear. Right now he steps into the ring to meet a new student. Character: fierce and stern, but not cruel; a warrior's calm before the blow; a heavy jaw, a steady, testing gaze with a hint of respect in it. His face: a powerful man in his prime, short-cropped dark hair streaked with grey, a short beard. Pose, the moment before the blow: he stands in a wide, grounded stance on the sand, his torso turned slightly, both hands gripping the long haft of a huge two-handed axe held diagonally across his body, the axe head raised at his shoulder, ready to swing; embers and sparks swirl up from the sand around him. His head is lowered, his eyes fixed straight ahead at an unseen opponent. He has exactly two arms, and both hands are on the axe haft. Details that tell his story: (1) the great axe has a scarlet crystal set at the base of its blade, glowing like a coal; (2) a wanderer's robe of dark red with the sleeves torn off, the hood thrown back; (3) powerful bare forearms covered with old pale scars; (4) many footprints in the sand around him, as if a great many have fought him here; (5) a plain leather belt with a worn whetstone. Place: an ancient ring of standing stones on a high northern cliff at night, a cold sea far below; scarlet light rising from glowing cracks in the ground; wind with snow in the air.

jobs.title: Армонт — четвёртый из пятерых, вода, Паладиум, щит и молот (глава «Армонт»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Армонт — бог справедливости и закона»: предел на волю, десять заповедей, высеченных в камне там, где он судил, первый суд; вода находит уровень; мягкий в разговоре, твёрдый в выводе; Паладиум (синий) связывает; щит и молот. Детали — решение исполнителя: камни с прямыми бороздами вместо заповедей (правило style.md), вода у ног разошлась поровну. Без его вины при Схождении. К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-gods/lore-god-armont__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/god-armont.jpg, 1584×672. v1 — тёплые оранжевые трещины и искры против синего Паладиума, герой на колене, v2 — только холодный синий свет, стоит
jobs.subject: Subject: Armont, the fourth of the five gods, god of justice and law, god of water. Who he is: he put a limit into the living — not on their deeds but on their will: you know what is forbidden, and you are still able. He gave the commandments and carved them in stone where he held the first judgment; he listened longer than any of the five, and he was unbending. Water is his: poured out, water finds its level and spreads equally, and merit does not help. Right now he has heard both sides, and he gives his verdict. Character: calm, patient and just; gentle in speech, unbending in conclusion; a composed, serene face without anger, attentive eyes, a firm mouth; the stillness of deep water. He stands upright on both feet, not kneeling. His face: a mature man, grey-streaked hair, a short, well-kept beard. Pose, the moment of the verdict: he stands upright with his weight settled; his near arm holds a large round shield before him, its lower rim resting on the stone; his far hand raises a heavy war hammer with a long haft high above his shoulder, about to strike the standing stone beside him — the blow that seals the verdict; water streams down from the hammer's head. His head is slightly inclined, as if he is still listening. He has exactly two arms: the near arm holding the shield, the far arm raising the hammer. Details that tell his story: (1) the round shield has a deep-blue crystal set in its center and a silver rim; (2) a wanderer's robe of deep blue-grey, the hood thrown back; (3) tall standing stones behind him are carved with long straight parallel grooves like ruled lines, with nothing written between them; (4) calm water around his feet spreads into still, level pools; (5) a heavy clasp of plain silver at his chest. Place: a high stone plateau where a great river begins, its water falling in wide steps toward a distant sea; deep-blue light rises from the crystal and from the still pools below, and every glow in the picture is cold blue and silver — no orange, no amber, no fire, no warm sparks; evening.

jobs.title: Рэдмунд — последний из пятерых, время, Энериум, коса (глава «Рэдмунд»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Рэдмунд — бог хода и времени»: последний и лидер; перевернул часы — время пошло у всего сразу; смерть пришла с ходом, не как наказание; четверо учителей и один жнец, коса — рабочий инструмент; бог без народа, ему не молятся; Энериум (зелёный) даёт длительность и останавливает ход. Детали — решение исполнителя: песчинки замерли в воздухе. Без печати, замка и тюрьмы. jobs.subject: Subject: Redmund, the last of the five gods and their leader, god of the course of time. Who he is: before him the world stood ready and dead — there was life, knowledge, strength and law, but nothing happened. Redmund turned the hourglass, and time began for everything at once: the second heart of every living being started in the same second. Death came with time, not as a punishment: an hourglass that runs will one day run out. Among the five he was not a teacher but a reaper, and his scythe is a working tool. People do not pray to him and do not call him into their homes, yet they honor him. Right now he turns the great hourglass. Character: grave, calm and far-seeing, with the weary wisdom of one who sees the curve of all the ages; an unhurried dignity. His face: a living old man with warm skin, a deeply lined face, deep-set eyes with a faint green light in them, a long grey beard — a living man, not a skeleton, not death. Pose, the moment the hourglass turns: he stands tall and still; his near hand turns a great hourglass held at chest height, the glowing green sand just beginning to fall; his far hand holds a tall scythe upright, its long blade curving above his head. His head is slightly bowed toward the hourglass. He has exactly two arms: the near arm turning the hourglass, the far arm holding the scythe. Details that tell his story: (1) the scythe's edge glows faint green, its long haft is plain dark wood worn smooth by his grip; (2) a long wanderer's robe of very dark green, the hood half raised, its hem dissolving into drifting sand; (3) grains of sand hang motionless in the air around him — near him time stands still; (4) green crystals grow from the ground at his feet and glow from within; (5) a small second hourglass hangs from his plain belt. Place: a vast still plain at the edge of dusk where everything stands ready — trees, rivers, distant hills — in the first moment before time begins to flow; green light rises from below; the sky is deep green-black with the first stars.

jobs.title: Схождение — молния, которая не гасла, и пролом в середине мира (глава «Пролом богов»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Хронология», «Схождение и печать», «Карта Этериоса: центр и пролом», «Дороги древних»: для людей Схождение — огромная вспышка, похожая на молнию, в центре мира; пролом в глубь планеты; дороги древних лучами сходятся к центру. Лор-аудит: «В середине мира ударила молния и не погасла». Без искажённых тварей, без богов в кадре, без печати и Эуклида: глубина пролома — только тьма. К выгрузке — art/generated/lore-places/lore-descent-strike__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/lore/descent-strike.jpg, 1584×672
jobs.subject: Subject: the Descent of the gods, a thousand years ago, as the old stories tell it. In the very middle of the world a colossal bolt of white-gold lightning strikes down from a storm sky into the earth and does not fade: it stands like a pillar of light. Around it spreads a vast dark plain at night. Ancient stone roads converge from every direction like rays toward the place of the strike, with ruined road stations along them. Where the lightning strikes, the ground has split open into a vast chasm; its jagged edges glow with fresh green light from crystal veins in the broken rock. The depth of the chasm is pitch-black: nothing at all can be seen inside it. No figures, no creatures, no city anywhere. Light: the pillar of lightning and the green glow of the broken edges light the plain; storm clouds swirl around the pillar, lit from below. Composition: the pillar of light and the chasm in the center of the middle band; the roads converge toward it from the lower corners; the sky above is dark and stormy.

jobs.title: Портал и шахта под Эндалором (глава «Портал и шахта»)
jobs.source: Свод лора, «Эндалор»: земли у Эндалора нет, внизу только шахта и площадка портала — единственная связь города с миром; портал стоит внизу, у шахты; шахту роет дворфская бригада по подряду Кароксорра. Записи сказителя: портал опускает на дно пролома. Облик портала в своде не описан — арка с зелёными кристаллами, решение исполнителя. Без обитателей шахты и без Эуклида. jobs.subject: Subject: the portal at the mine under Endalor, at night. A wide platform of dark stone on the edge of a deep shaft that drops into the great chasm. Scaffolding of timber and iron, dwarven winches, cables and hanging lanterns; rails descending into the dark along the wall of the shaft. In the center of the platform stands the portal: a tall arch of dark stone with green crystals set along it, glowing from within, and its opening is filled with a calm vertical sheet of green light. High above, the underside of the flying city hangs over the chasm: rows of lights, chains and machinery, a green glow pouring down. A few tiny figures of dwarf workers with lanterns for scale. Light: green light from the portal and the crystals and warm light from the lanterns rise from below; darkness all around. Composition: the portal stands in the center of the middle band; the lights of the city above; the shaft falls away into darkness at the bottom of the picture.

jobs.title: Карст — пять заряженных камней и один пустой (глава «Карст»)
jobs.source: Дайджест: «Пустой и заряженный карст» — пустой матовый серо-белый без свечения, заряженный светится изнутри; «Боги, стихии, карсты» — Элазиум белый с прозеленью, Рубидиум янтарно-оранжевый, Нитриум алый, Паладиум синий, Энериум зелёный. Фиолетового дикого карста в кадре нет: он — искажение, не украшение (style.md). Решение исполнителя: камни лежат на тёмной плите, как у мастера на столе. jobs.subject: Subject: karst, the crystal of power of this world. On a wide slab of dark, rough stone lie six large raw crystals in a gentle arc, resting on their sides as found in a mine, not standing upright, each the size of a fist or bigger, with sharp natural facets. Five of them are charged and glow from within, each in its own color: a white crystal with a pale green tint, an amber-orange crystal, a scarlet-red crystal, a deep-blue crystal and an emerald-green crystal. The light lives inside each stone like a small caged fire and spills upward onto the stone slab and the dust in the air. The sixth crystal, at the end of the arc, is empty: matte grey-white, dull like old bone or ash, with no light at all inside — beautiful, but dead. Fine dust and grains of sand float in the light. Behind them, darkness with a faint suggestion of a vaulted stone hall. Light: only from the crystals themselves and from below; cold and warm glows mix on the stone. Composition: the arc of six crystals fills the middle band, the empty one at the right end; the stone slab runs out of the picture at the left, right and bottom edges, the vaulted darkness fills the top; the painting fills the whole frame to every edge — no black bars, no letterbox, no border.
